content.title: Cross-Scale Stage Partners | Gesture Orbit, Palm Rest and Shared Pose
content.summary: An adult singer and a palm-sized glass moth turn one hand arc into a shared club-stage bow. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult primary performer and one original miniature companion retain distinct stable identities. + The environment supplies continuous scale references for both characters. + Every companion move visibly answers a preceding adult gesture along a traceable route. + The miniature companion reaches the hand through one continuous orbit without arbitrary scale change or teleportation. + A shared terminal pose keeps both scales, identities and the original stage readable at once.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult jazz singer with a silver bob, emerald suit and crescent brooch on a midnight-blue club stage beside a cream grand piano. The singer traces one slow semicircle with her microphone hand; the moth follows that exact arc through foreground light and answers with two wing flashes. End on a wide shared bow beneath the exact original title "SMALL LIGHT / BIG STAGE", with singer, moth, piano and club geometry unchanged.
required_anchors: One clearly adult primary performer and one original miniature companion retain distinct stable identities.
The environment supplies continuous scale references for both characters.
The miniature companion reaches the hand through one continuous orbit without arbitrary scale change or teleportation.
A shared terminal pose keeps both scales, identities and the original stage readable at once.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult singer and a palm-sized glass moth turn one hand arc into a shared club-stage bow. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定成年表演者、微型原创伙伴和同一舞台，先用独立动作建立双方身份，再让小伙伴沿可追踪环线回应人物手势；终局必须落到人物手掌或近身位置，并以共同姿态证明跨尺度关系。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult primary performer and one original miniature companion retain distinct stable identities.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult primary performer and one original miniature companion retain distinct stable identities."

invariants.rule: The environment supplies continuous scale references for both characters.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The environment supplies continuous scale references for both characters."

invariants.rule: Every companion move visibly answers a preceding adult gesture along a traceable route.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every companion move visibly answers a preceding adult gesture along a traceable route."

invariants.rule: The miniature companion reaches the hand through one continuous orbit without arbitrary scale change or teleportation.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The miniature companion reaches the hand through one continuous orbit without arbitrary scale change or teleportation."

invariants.rule: A shared terminal pose keeps both scales, identities and the original stage readable at once.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "A shared terminal pose keeps both scales, identities and the original stage readable at once."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
